15. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[14]], the method comprising:
accessing a second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers;
adding information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information indicative of the at least one server computer comprises load information for the at least one server computer__;
providing the locator to a client computer; and
selecting a first server computer from the first set of server computers based on the information added to the locator.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __and providing the information indicative of the at least one server computer to a media request broker in response to the http request__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[16]] __15__, further comprising __providing the information indicative of the at least one server computer to a media request broker__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information.
